## About this app

*arrow_forward*

The Saudi Visa Bio app is the simplest way for visitors to Saudi Arabia to securely submit their biometric data as part of their visa application process.\
\
Once you have applied for a visa to enter Saudi Arabia, the Saudi Visa Bio app will help you submit your fingerprints and facial image. Using this app you can complete your biometric enrollment process anytime, anywhere — no need to visit or queue at a Visa Service Center, all you need is your smartphone and passport.\
\
With the Saudi Visa Bio app you can easily:\
- Submit your personal information, such as passport details and visa application number\
- Submit your biometric information i.e., facial image and fingerprints\
- Complete your biometric enrollment process in real-time in under 10 minutes\
\
To complete the biometric enrollment process the Saudi Visa Bio app will need to collect:\
- A valid email address\
- A photo capture of your passport and the passport details\
- A photo capture of your face\
- A photo capture of your fingers\
\
Your privacy is important to us; the data collected will only be used to verify your identity in order to complete your visa application process. All collected data will be automatically deleted from the app once the biometric enrollment has been completed.\
\
The Saudi Biometric Enrollment app is currently available for the following visas:\
- Umrah\
\
Please note that you have to be aged 6+ to use the Saudi Biometric Enrollment app. Users under 18 years of age can only use the app under adult supervision.

Submit your biometric data as part of your visa application process

Our attempt to scan all ten fingers through the Saudi app has repeatedly failed. Despite trying at least ten times, we couldn't complete the process, which is extremely frustrating. We used both Wi-Fi and Grameen 4G networks, but success eluded us. It now seems that we may have to rely on agents for assistance. This lengthy process has become time-consuming and disappointing for us. In this age of advanced technology, such complications are unexpected.
